title: The Axolotl That Never Grows Up
description: The axolotl is a salamander from the lakes of Mexico that reaches sexual maturity without metamorphosis, so adults keep their external gills and stay in the water. It can regenerate limbs, gills and parts of its eyes and brain, so scientists use it in research. In the wild it is critically endangered. Source: Wikipedia, Axolotl.
